record.field: Search CRM leads and opportunities by customer or opportunity title.
Retrieve detailed summary of a specific CRM lead including revenue, stage, salesperson, and description.
Create a new CRM lead or opportunity with customer details and expected revenue.
Search sales orders and quotations by order number or customer name.
Retrieve line items, quantities, pricing, and total amounts for a specific sales order.
Create a new draft sales order or quotation for a customer with product order lines.
Check outstanding receivable credit or payable debit for a specific partner.
Search customer invoices by partner ID or payment state (not_paid, paid, in_payment).
Search purchase orders, requests for quotation (RFQs), and vendor orders by vendor name or order reference (e.g. P00014).

Create a new Purchase Order or Request for Quotation (RFQ) for a supplier/vendor with product lines, quantities, and UoM. If the purchase module is not installed, prompts the user to install it first.
Check on-hand quantity, forecasted virtual quantity, and unit price for products.
Search project tasks by task title or project ID.
Schedule an activity (call, reminder, follow-up) on any Odoo document.
Post an internal note or message to a document chatter.
Inspect fields, data types, and relational requirements for ANY installed Odoo model (e.g. sale.order, account.move, stock.picking, purchase.order, crm.lead, hr.employee, project.task, etc.).
Search and read records from ANY installed Odoo model with domain filters and field selection.
Create a new record in ANY installed Odoo model (e.g. purchase order, invoice, contact, product, project task, warehouse transfer). Generates an action proposal requiring user confirmation.
Update fields on an existing record in ANY installed Odoo model. Generates an action proposal requiring user confirmation.
Permanently delete a record from ANY installed Odoo model. Generates a strict action proposal requiring user approval.
List Odoo apps and modules with their current state (installed, uninstalled, to upgrade) and summary description.
Install an Odoo module or app by technical name (e.g. sale, purchase, crm, stock, project, hr). Requires admin approval.
Upgrade an installed Odoo app or module to reload code and views. Requires admin approval.
Uninstall an installed Odoo app or module. Requires admin approval.
Create and configure an automated business rule (base.automation) for actions triggered on record creation or updates.
Summarize company financial report metrics, total revenue invoiced, and open receivable balance totals.

Inspect current configuration settings across any installed Odoo app (Inventory, Sales, Purchase, Accounting, or custom modules). Returns whether settings like Storage Locations, Multi-Step Routes, Packages, Lots, Variants, etc. are enabled or disabled.
Enable or disable system configuration settings across any installed Odoo app (Inventory, Sales, Purchase, Accounting, or custom modules). Changes are confirmed by the user before being applied.
